title: Guadalajara Cartel Co-Founder Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo Dies at 80
detail: Félix Gallardo, the 'Boss of Bosses' and Guadalajara Cartel co-founder, died Nov 15 of multiple organ failure at a private hospital in Guadalajara, Jalisco. He had been imprisoned since April 1989 and was serving sentences totalling 77 years, including for the 1985 murder of DEA agent Enrique Camarena. Courts had repeatedly refused his house-arrest requests.
